chain.title: Dust That Remembers Places
chain.desc: Grind an amethyst shard together with an ender pearl into warp dust, the raw reagent of every teleport in the mod.

chain.title: A Stone That Skips You Home
chain.desc: An emerald, amethyst shard and ender pearl make the reusable warp stone, which teleports you on a cooldown.

chain.title: Plant Your First Landmark
chain.desc: Stone bricks, obsidian and a warp stone build the waystone. Activate one and it joins your permanent travel list.

chain.title: The Way Back, On Paper
chain.desc: Paper, gold nuggets and purple dye make a reusable return scroll that always sends you to your bound waystone.

chain.title: Tethered Parchment
chain.desc: Adding an ender pearl lets the bound scroll lock onto one chosen waystone and return there again and again.

chain.title: One Leap, Then Ash
chain.desc: The warp scroll spends itself on a single trip to any waystone you have already discovered.

chain.title: A Network Others Can Use
chain.desc: The sharestone links to every other colourless sharestone, letting a whole server hop between them.

chain.title: Paint The Network Red
chain.desc: Dye a sharestone red and it will only connect to other red sharestones, carving a private line out of the shared network.

chain.title: The Public Directory
chain.desc: Polished andesite and a warp stone make the portstone: it lists every waystone you know but cannot be teleported to itself.

chain.title: Step On, Step Out
chain.desc: Warp dust, flint and stone bricks form a pressure-triggered plate that fires anything standing on it to a linked plate.

chain.title: Tuning Fork For Two Plates
chain.desc: Flint and warp dust make the attuned shard; slot it into one warp plate, carry it to another, and the pair is linked.

chain.title: A Shard With One Trip Left
chain.desc: The cheap amethyst-and-pearl variant works exactly once before it is consumed on teleport.

notes: Small mod: the jar holds only 34 recipes and 32 lang-verified item ids, so a 12-step chain covers it end to end. Recipe spine verified from data/waystones/recipes/: warp_dust = amethyst_shard + ender_pearl; warp_stone = #balm:emeralds + amethyst_shard + ender_pearl; every waystone/sharestone/portstone variant consumes a warp_stone; warp_plate and attuned_shard consume warp_dust; crumbling_attuned_shard = amethyst_shard + ender_pearl (no warp_dust, hence the cheaper single-use tier). Scroll ladder verified: return_scroll (paper + gold nuggets + purple dye) -> bound_scroll and warp_scroll both add an ender_pearl. Note the jar's recipes reference #balm:* dye/emerald/gold_nugget tags, so Balm is a hard dependency for crafting anything here. MODDB CONFLICT: moddb puts waystones:red_sharestone at pos 0.0 and waystones:waystone at 0.205, ahead of warp_dust/warp_stone at 0.5. That reflects packs handing out found-in-world waystones as an opening quest; the crafting graph strictly requires warp_dust -> warp_stone first, and that order is used here. moddb otherwise agrees: sharestone 0.259 < portstone 0.554 < warp_plate 0.661 < warp_scroll 0.857. DROPPED: waystones:black_sharestone was cut only to keep the sharestone wheel at the 14-member cap; the id is valid. mossy_waystone also has a second recipe (vine + waystone) besides the warp_stone one. ID VERIFICATION: every id in this file was set-membership-checked against the jar; nothing was dropped.
